item.title: Bandit Algorithm Cha1 Notes
item.description: Stochastic Bandit: a collection of distributions (\nv = (P_a: a\in\mathcal{A})) where $\mathcal{A}$ is a set of available actions. The learner and the environment interact sequentially over n rounds. In each round $t\in{1,…,n}$ the learner chooses an action $A_t\in\mathcal{A}$, which is fed to the environment. The environment then samples a reward $Xt\in\mathbb{R}$ from the distribution $P{A_t}$, and reveals $X_t$ to the learner. Environment class: the class $\Epsilon$ a bandit $\nu$ belongs to.
